pricingSnapshot.description: Experiment pricing snapshot — not live provider billing; historical reports remain reproducible via embedded snapshot. Rates are benchmark baselines for opencode-go/muse-spark-1.2-contributor.

costMethodology.costCalculation: inputCost = inputTokens/1M * inputUsdPerMillion; outputCost = outputTokens/1M * outputUsdPerMillion; totalCost = inputCost+outputCost. If provider returns trustworthy cost, prefer provider cost and record source. If tokens unavailable, costUsd=null costStatus=unavailable, never $0.
